title: Bally's $BALY gave back almost all of yesterday's pop. DOWN -6.8% to $9.93 today.
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
The spark: Wednesday's +11.5% relief rally on $560M of new financing is reversing, while Truist cut its target to $9 and Barclays sits at Underweight with a $7 target.  
  
The "going concern" language is still out there, and the stock is not far from its $8.44 52-week low.
